# 법무법인(유한) 대륜 (Daeryun Law Firm)

> > Daeryun Law Firm is a comprehensive Korean legal practice offering AI-powered legal services, nationwide representation, and 24/7 consultation across criminal defense, corporate law, family law, and civil litigation.

Daeryun is a limited liability law corporation with offices across South Korea (including Seoul, Gwangju, and Jeju) and international presence in New York and Washington D.C. The firm specializes in criminal defense (DUI, assault, fraud), corporate matters (fair trade, IP, labor), family law (guardianship, paternity), and civil litigation (debt recovery, construction disputes).

## Criminal Defense Case Studies

- [음주도주치상 사례 | 음주측정거부, 도주치상 의뢰인 감형 성공](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/9999): DUI case: reduced sentence for hit-and-run with breath test refusal
- [아동복지법위반 | 아동복지법 위반해 실형 받았으나 항소로 집행유예](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/9165): Criminal case: suspended sentence achieved on Child Welfare Law appeal
- [강제추행 | 실형 위기에서 집행유예 이끈 사례](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/10579): Sexual assault case: suspended sentence achieved from prison threat
- [스토킹법 | 직장 내 연락으로 피소된 사건, '불기소'로 종결](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/10836): Stalking case: non-prosecution for workplace contact allegations
- [모욕죄 | 학원 강사 모욕죄로 고소 당했으나 불기소 결정](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/10074): Defamation case: non-prosecution for academy instructor insult claim

## Corporate & Business Law Cases

- [부정경쟁방지및영업비밀보호법 | 부정경쟁방지법, 상표법 위반한 기업 대표 "불기소"](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/10493): IP case: non-prosecution for unfair competition and trademark violation
- [공정위 조사 대응 사례 | 제조업체 계열사 부당지원행위 무혐의](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/9445): FTC case: no charges for manufacturer affiliate unfair support claims
- [물품대금내용증명 | 물품대금 청구 소송을 통해 약 1억 원의 미지급 대금 회수 성공](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/10462): Commercial case: 100M won recovered through goods payment litigation
- [노동조합 교섭 자문 | 단체협약·임금협약 원만 타결](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/9618): Labor case: successful collective bargaining and wage agreement
- [징계무효소송 | 징계처분무효소송 항소심 대리해 원고 청구 기각시킨 사례](https://www.daeryunlaw.com/success_new/9982): Labor case: disciplinary action upheld in cooperative dismissal appeal
